0022600037.text: Atlanta visits Chicago for its 13th game of the season, sitting at 7-5 and first in the Southeast, with a 4-2 road record and a 5-5 mark over its last ten after a loss in its most recent game. The Bulls are 1-8, 14th in the East, and on a seven-game losing streak, with an 0-3 home record, and the teams have not met yet this season. In 2025-26 the Hawks lost 0-3 in the season series, most recently a 126-123 loss in Atlanta on December 23, 2025. The Hawks will be without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
